problem: Apple wanted control over its mapping experience.
title: Apple replaces Google Maps in iOS 6 and publicly apologises
context: iOS 6 dropped Google Maps in favour of Apple's own Maps app.
decision_made: Ship its own Maps app in iOS 6 in place of Google Maps.
action_taken: Within nine days of release CEO Tim Cook published an open letter saying Apple was extremely sorry for the frustration and pointing users to alternatives, including Google's.
observed_outcome: Apple publicly acknowledged the app fell short and recommended competing map services in the meantime.
lessons: Replacing a trusted service with an unfinished one can force a public apology.
limitations: Only the apology period was checked. Later improvement of Apple Maps was not covered here.

claims.claim_text: Apple replaced Google Maps with its own Maps app in iOS 6.
Tim Cook published an open letter apologising and suggesting competing map apps.
